# Vulngraph

> A self-hosted security graph for cloud accounts. It maps cloud assets, IAM identities, container images,
> packages and repositories into one graph and ranks findings by what an attacker can actually reach. Apache-2.0,
> Go, Postgres, ClickHouse. Read-only by default; it never changes anything without a person's approval.

Pre-1.0, one maintainer, built with AI coding assistance, used internally before this first public release. Connectors start read-only.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/vulngraph/vulngraph/blob/main/README.md): what it is, the quickstart and a short tour
- [Evaluating Vulngraph](https://github.com/vulngraph/vulngraph/blob/main/docs/evaluating.md): what access it needs, how to try it safely, where to check each claim
- [Getting started](https://github.com/vulngraph/vulngraph/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): run it locally, load the demo, connect a cloud, production
- [Connecting your accounts](https://github.com/vulngraph/vulngraph/blob/main/docs/connecting.md): per-provider setup for AWS, GCP, Azure, GitHub, Okta, Google Workspace, Kubernetes
- [Examples](https://github.com/vulngraph/vulngraph/blob/main/docs/examples.md): screenshots and recordings from the bundled demo account
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/vulngraph/vulngraph/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): direction, not promises; what is next, later and not planned
- [FAQ](https://github.com/vulngraph/vulngraph/blob/main/docs/faq.md): write access, LLMs, egress, freshness, what it is not

- [Architecture](https://github.com/vulngraph/vulngraph/blob/main/docs/architecture.md)
